explain ops=R5
requirement R1 Rendering the same keys in a new order puts the nodes in that order and keeps every one of them
requirement R2 A reorder together with new and removed keys: kept children keep their nodes, in the new order
requirement R3 An input keeps what was typed into it when its item moves, and typing into it afterwards still works
requirement R4 A child that moves still receives its new props and text
requirement R5 `ops create remove` is 0 0 for a pure reorder, and counts only the new and removed children otherwise
requirement R6 Lists inside items reorder on their own, and an item that moves takes its nested nodes along
requirement R7 Keys such as "", "0", "1" and "01" move like any other key
requirement R8 Children without a key still match by position, even when their texts are reordered
requirement R9 Long runs of reorders, insertions and removals
requirement E2E Whole sessions on sortable lists
